programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk helps the mafia / Mr. Monk hilft der Mafia
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. programme.title: Auf Streife
programme.sub-title: About the blade / Über die Klinge
programme.desc: The series accompanies police officers in their everyday work based on real traps. They are in use around the clock. The trap of violent clashes, homely violence and drug abuse are shown. The range of police work is enormous. It is not just a limits to the warpage of crimes. The officials on patrol also help confused people such as pensioners who have forgotten their address or young people who need role models in their puberty. / Die Serie begleitet Polizisten bei ihren alltaglichen Einsatzen, die auf realen Fallen basieren. Dabei sind sie rund um die Uhr im Einsatz. Gezeigt werden Falle von gewalttatigen Auseinandersetzungen, hauslicher Gewalt sowie Drogenmissbrauch. Die Bandbreite an Polizeiarbeit ist enorm. Sie beschrankt sich nicht nur auf die Bekampfung von Verbrechen. Die Beamten auf Streife helfen auch verwirrten Menschen wie etwa Rentnern, die ihre Adresse vergessen haben oder Jugendlichen, die in ihrem pubertaren Leichtsinn Vorbilder brauchen.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.desc: For the opening round of Group D, USA and Colombia face at SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay, Philippines. programme.title: Green Bay Packers x Washington Commanders
programme.desc: For week 2 of the regular season, the Packers (1-0) receive the Commanders (1-0) at Lambeau Field in Green Bay, USA. Os donos da casa estrearam vencendo o Detroit Lions por 27 a 13, enquanto a equipe de Washington fez 21 a 6 no New York Giants.

programme.title: Brasil x China
programme.desc: For the opening round of Group H, Brazil and China play at SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay, Philippines. programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Spartan race / Надпревара "Спартан"
programme.desc: These are exhausting competitions that combine running for endurance, strength and mental resistance. Participants are oriented through a series of obstacles designed to experience the limit on their borders. They can include climbing walls, heavy wearing objects, rope climbing, mud pits and fire. / Това са изтощителни състезания, които съчетават бягане за издръжливост, сила и психическа устойчивост. Участниците се ориентират през поредица от препятствия, предназначени да изпитат предела на техните граници. Те могат да включват стени за изкачване, тежки предмети за носене, катерене по въжета, кални ями и огън.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: The sectarian Ethan is the last to see Vern Armstrong alive. Therefore, the suspicions fall on it. But Dr. Blake finds strange deficiencies and coincidences pointing to another perpetrator. / Сектантът Итън е последният, който е видял жив Върн Армстронг. Затова подозренията падат върху него. Но д-р Блейк открива странни липси и съвпадения, сочещи към друг извършител.

programme.title: Arena Sports / Арена спорт
programme.desc: The analytical information sports show "Arena Sport" will take viewers beyond the pure news in the sport, expanding them not only with a picture, but also with the first comments and reactions to what is happening. / Аналитично-информационното спортно предаване "Арена Спорт" ще отведе зрителите отвъд чистите новини в спорта, като ги разшири и обогати не само с картина, но и с първите коментари и реакции на случващото се.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Freestyle, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Свободен стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Germany / Колоездене: Обиколка на Германия
programme.desc: The tour of Germany is one of the largest and most prestigious cycling competitions in Germany. Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: Due to Lucian Blake's hasty decision to refer to his drunkenness as a reason for a divorce, all his patients cancel his hours, and Inspector Lawson chases him from the area. He even fired him from the position of a police doctor. But with that the trouble is not over - someone kills and hurts people from the doctor's environment. It turns out that behind everything stands the mourner father who lost his daughters because of Dr. Blake. In the end, the killer was captured and Jean scheduled a wedding date. At Christmas, everyone receives a favorite gift and warmth. / Заради прибързаното решение на Лусиън Блейк да посочи пиянството си като причина за развод, всичките му пациенти отменят часовете си, а инспектор Лоусън го гони от участъка. Дори го уволнява от позицията на полицейски лекар. Но с това неприятностите не приключват – някой убива и наранява хора от обкръжението на доктора. Оказва се, че зад всичко стои опечаленият баща, изгубил дъщерите си заради д-р Блейк. В крайна сметка убиецът е заловен, а Джийн насрочва дата за сватба. По Коледа всеки получава любим подарък и топлина.

programme.title: All roads water in Rome / Svi putevi vode u Rim
programme.desc: Meggie is a single mother from New York, who goes on a trip to Tuscany with her rebellious daughter Summer. There he meets his ex -husband, from whom Summer steals the car and runs into Rome. The adventurous search for Summer begins in which former lovers reveal mutual understanding. / Meggie je samohrana majka iz New Yorka koja kreće na put u Toskanu sa svojom buntovnom kćeri Summer. Ondje susreće svojeg bivšeg supruga od kojega Summer krade automobil i bježi u Rim. Počinje avanturistička potraga za Summer u kojoj bivši ljubavnici iznova otkrivaju uzajamno razumijevanje.

programme.title: People you may know / LJUDI KOJE MOŽDA ZNAŠ
Documentary: Angel's jump / DOKUMENTARNI FILM: SKOK ANĐELA
Zadatak
programme.desc: The paid killer Frank Kitchen gets a deadly task, but after being played by the people who hired him, he wakes up after surgery, revealing that he is no longer a man but a woman. In search of revenge, Frank clashes with a woman who transformed him, Dr. Rachel Jane, who herself has her reasons, the revenge of the murdered brother. / Plaćeni ubojica Frank Kitchen dobiva smrtonosni zadatak, ali nakon što su ga izigrali ljudi koji su ga angažirali, on se budi poslije operacije, pri čemu otkriva da više nije muškarac nego žena. U potrazi za osvetom, Frank se sukobljava sa ženom koja ga je transformirala, doktoricom Rachel Jane, koja i sama ima svoje razloge, osvetu ubijenog brata.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: As one of the oldest still existing news programs on German television, the magazine has been broadcast since December 1952. The current events are reported at home and abroad. / Als eine der altesten noch bestehenden Nachrichtensendungen im deutschen Fernsehen wird das Magazin bereits seit Dezember 1952 ausgestrahlt. Berichtet wird uber das aktuelle Geschehen im In- und Ausland.

programme.title: Todliche Schatten
programme.desc: The murder of two colleagues presents the Berlin LKA with great challenges: both police officers had neither professional nor privately in contact - where is the connection? Commissioner Philip Nabrow (Walter Sittler), as brilliantly as stubborn, and his colleague Frauke Johannsen (Charlotte Irene Thompson) determine in all directions: Murder from Refuge? Protection funds? Homophobia or clan-skilled? But the different traces run into nothing. However, when the police boxing club jerks at the center of the investigation, the case takes an unexpected turn: in the club, which is led by former police officer Hartmut Jenke (Rainer Woss), Nabrow's daughter Elisa (Hannah Ehrlichmann) is also involved in the case. As much as Nabrow hangs on his daughter and her work hesitates, the plidious close cooperation gives him discomfort, because: Nabrow has secrets that he wants to hide from all circumstances from Elisa. Does Nabrow lose control? His superior and best friend Fred Keitel (Uwe Preuss) has every reason to worry, especially since the case is becoming increasingly complex and dangerous. And suddenly Nabrow himself becomes a hunted! / Der Mord an zwei Kollegen stellt das Berliner LKA vor groSSe Herausforderungen: Beide Polizisten hatten weder beruflich noch privat Kontakt - wo ist die Verbindung? Kommissar Philip Nabrow (Walter Sittler), ebenso brillant wie dickkopfig, und seine Kollegin Frauke Johannsen (Charlotte Irene Thompson) ermitteln in alle Richtungen: Mord aus Auslanderhass? Schutzgelderpressung? Homophobie oder Clan-Geschafte? Doch die verschiedenen Spuren laufen ins Leere. Als jedoch der Polizei-Boxclub ins Zentrum der Ermittlungen ruckt, nimmt der Fall eine unerwartete Wende: Im Club, der von dem ehemaligen Polizisten Hartmut Jenke (Rainer Woss) geleitet wird, wird kraftig gedealt - so dass auch Nabrows Tochter Elisa (Hannah Ehrlichmann) aus dem Drogendezernat in den Fall involviert wird. So sehr Nabrow an seiner Tochter hangt und ihre Arbeit schatzt, die plotzliche enge Zusammenarbeit bereitet ihm Unbehagen, denn: Nabrow hat Geheimnisse, die er unter allen Umstanden vor Elisa verbergen will. Verliert Nabrow die Kontrolle? Sein Vorgesetzter und bester Freund Fred Keitel (Uwe Preuss) hat allen Grund zur Sorge, zumal der Fall immer komplexer und gefahrlicher wird. Und auf einmal wird Nabrow selbst zum Gejagten!

programme.title: The Amsterdam thriller: the dirt of the others / Der Amsterdam-Krimi: Der Dreck der Anderen
programme.desc: Commissioner Bram de Groot (Fedja van Huet) and his team are played up a distant video: At a gauze deponation in Malaysia, the dead body of a little boy lies between highly toxic September! The trace goes to the renowned recycling company "Golden Wings Logistics", which is based in Amsterdam, whose owner Laura Lee (Joy Maria Bai) is a personality, which is raised because of her social engagement. A procedure against Lee can only take place with an out -of -date sensitivity. Bram de Groot Schleust Alex Pollack (Hannes Jaenicke), his specialists for undercover campaigns, in the company. A wire rope act for the experienced police officer, who is drawn deeper and deeper into the criminal machinations during his action. He finds evidence of illegal mulling and drug smuggling. A raid fails - was it pierced? Is there a trial in Bram's team? The location is heading when Alex suddenly disappeared without a trace. / Kommissar Bram de Groot (Fedja van Huet) und seinem Team wird ein verstorendes Video zugespielt: Auf einer Mulldeponie in Malaysia liegt der tote Korper eines kleinen Jungen zwischen hochgiftigem Sondermull aus Europa! Die Spur fuhrt zu dem renommierten, in Amsterdam ansassigen Recyclingunternehmen "Golden Wings Logistics", dessen Eigentumerin Laura Lee (Joy Maria Bai) eine wegen ihres sozialen Engagements hochgeachtete Personlichkeit ist. Ein Vorgehen gegen Lee kann nur mit auSSerster Sensibilitat erfolgen. Bram de Groot schleust Alex Pollack (Hannes Jaenicke), seinen Spezialisten fur Undercover-Aktionen, in das Unternehmen ein. Ein Drahtseilakt fur den erfahrenen Polizisten, der wahrend seiner Aktion immer tiefer in die kriminellen Machenschaften gezogen wird. Er findet Hinweise auf illegale Mullverschiebung und Drogenschmuggel. Eine Razzia scheitert - wurde sie durchgestochen? Gibt es einen Verrater in Brams Team? Die Lage spitzt sich zu, als Alex plotzlich spurlos verschwunden ist.

programme.title: Deutschlandbilder
programme.desc: With the camera when traveling: The show shows the barnest pages of German city and landscapes in calm, uncomfortable and music -accompanied recordings. / Mit der Kamera auf Reisen: Die Sendung zeigt in ruhigen, unkommentierten und mit Musik untermalten Aufnahmen die schonsten Seiten deutscher Stadte und Landschaften.

programme.title: HipHorses - you and your horse / HipHorses - Du und Dein Pferd
programme.desc: Handstand and balancing act on the jerking of a horse? This is no problem for Zoe from Delitzsch. She has been vaulting for six years and has nobody trusted nobody than her horse Rubin Fiorello. Together with her team, the 13-year-old trains for a tournament in which she wants to show a balancing act free and without help. Whether Zoe succeeds? Tips and tricks about vaulting horse is also available from horse expert Nina Eichinger. / Handstand und Spagat-Sprung auf dem Rucken eines Pferdes? Das ist fur Zoe aus Delitzsch kein Problem. Sie voltigiert schon seit sechs Jahren und vertraut niemandem mehr als ihrem Pferd Rubin Fiorello. Zusammen mit ihrem Team trainiert die 13-Jahrige fur ein Turnier, bei dem sie einen Spagat-Sprung frei und ohne Hilfe zeigen will. Ob Zoe das gelingt?Tipps und Tricks rund ums Voltigier-Pferd gibt es zudem von Pferde-Expertin Nina Eichinger.

programme.title: Zora am Morgen
programme.desc: Zora's days start Fruh - if most of her friends are still sleeping firmly, she is already training with her gymnastics teacher. Tomorrow she should be examined - maybe she can even go to the national championship? But nobody suspects that Zora has another passion - she loves football. On the day of the big inspection, she gave her the opportunity to play with an important game - how should she decide? / Zoras Tage beginnen fruh - wenn die meisten ihrer Freunde noch fest schlafen, trainiert sie schon mit ihrer Gymnastiklehrerin. Morgen soll sie gepruft werden - vielleicht darf sie sogar zur Landesmeisterschaft? Doch niemand ahnt, dass Zora noch eine weitere Leidenschaft hat - sie liebt FuSSball. Ausgerechnet am Tag der groSSen Prufung bietet sich ihr die Gelegenheit, bei einem wichtigen Spiel mitzuspielen - wie soll sie sich entscheiden?

programme.title: Tigerenten Club
programme.desc: In an emergency you will be called! Christian Manshen and Mike Rauch give insights into their job as an emergency afternoon in the "Tigerenter Club". How do you stop on an emergency call, how does first aid work and what happens in an ambulance? In their humorous and encouraging way, the sanitators and influencers show how everyone can provide first aid in an emergency. With their profit, the classes support the children's aid campaign "Heart Safe" by SWR and SR. / Bei einem Notfall werden sie gerufen! Christian Manshen und Mike Rauch geben im "Tigerenten Club" Einblicke in ihren Job als Notfallsanitater. Wie verhalt man sich bei einem Notruf, wie funktioniert Erste Hilfe und was passiert in einem Rettungswagen? Die Sanitater und Influencer zeigen in ihrer humorvollen und ermutigenden Art, wie jeder im Ernstfall Erste Hilfe leisten kann.In der Spielearena spielen die Frosche von der Realschule Rheinstetten gegen die Tigerenten vom Erasmus-Widmann-Gymnasium aus Schwabisch Hall um den Goldpokal. Die Klassen unterstutzen mit ihrem Gewinn die Kinderhilfsaktion "Herzenssache" von SWR und SR.

programme.title: Unheimlich perfekte Freunde
programme.desc: Emil and Frido are best friends. When the mirror images of the two are brought to life in a mirror cabinet, the ten -year boys believe that they have pulled the big lot: the double gangs can do everything that Frido and Emil themselves cannot do so well, but they expect their ambitious parents from them. But when their images suddenly begin to pursue their own goals, the two friends have to find a way to get rid of the uncanny spirits they called. But that is more difficult than expected. / Emil und Frido sind beste Freunde. Als in einem Spiegelkabinett auf dem Jahrmarkt die Spiegelbilder der beiden zum Leben erweckt werden, glauben die zehnjahrigen Jungs, das groSSe Los gezogen zu haben: Die Doppelganger konnen namlich all das, was Frido und Emil selbst nicht so gut konnen, ihre ambitionierten Eltern aber von ihnen erwarten. Doch als ihre Abbilder plotzlich beginnen, eigene Ziele zu verfolgen, mussen die beiden Freunde einen Weg finden, die unheimlichen Geister, die sie riefen, wieder loszuwerden. Das aber gestaltet sich schwieriger als gedacht.

programme.title: Tiere bis unters Dach
programme.desc: Jakob's seventiest birthday is imminent. His childhood friend Otto suddenly appears, who makes a surprise visit with his elderly Labrador Hannibal. Jakob didn't really want to celebrate. But in contrast to Jakob, Otto is a happy journeyman who, especially through Hannibal, conquered the hearts of the children at the horse farm and reminds Jakob of an old promise that must now be accorded. The promise means a lot of fun, but no peace. But shortly before the big day, Hannibal collapses. Kajo's diagnosis is clear: the Labrador has a tumor. Can the children's darling be saved? What will become of Jakob's birthday party? / Jakobs siebzigster Geburtstag steht bevor. Plotzlich taucht sein Jugendfreund Otto auf, der mit seinem betagten Labrador Hannibal einen Überraschungsbesuch macht. Jakob wollte eigentlich keinesfalls feiern. Doch Otto ist im Gegensatz zu Jakob ein frohlicher Geselle, der vor allem durch Hannibal die Herzen der Kinder auf dem Pferdehof erobert und Jakob an ein altes Versprechen erinnert, das jetzt eingelost werden musse. Das Versprechen bedeutet viel SpaSS, aber keine Ruhe. Doch kurz vor dem groSSen Tag bricht Hannibal zusammen. Kajos Diagnose ist eindeutig: Der Labrador hat einen Tumor. Kann der Liebling der Kinder noch gerettet werden? Was wird aus Jakobs Geburtstagsfeier?

programme.title: Tiere bis unters Dach
programme.sub-title: Sam and Sammy / Sam und Sammy
programme.desc: In Winters, a very prominent animal patient moves in very much to the delight of Sam: Sammy, the truthful turtle. She apparently correctly predicted all the results of the last World Cup. Kajo should cure her from a stomach colic as soon as possible. As Sabrina, the attractive ex-girlfriend of Kajo, with her daughter Zoe for the tennis tournament in Waldau, Sam takes the opportunity to test the turtle's patties extensively. Because he might impress the Hubsche Zoe. Valentin also shows great interest in Sammy, because he might make the big Reibach by betting at the tennis tournament. Now it will show: Can the animal fortune tell you what everyone is promising from him? / Bei Winters zieht sehr zur Freude von Sam ein auSSerst prominenter tierischer Patient ein: Sammy, die wahrsagende Schildkrote. Alle Ergebnisse der letzten FuSSball-Weltmeisterschaft hat sie offenbar richtig vorhergesagt. Kajo soll sie schnellstens von einer Magenkolik kurieren. Als Sabrina, die attraktive Ex-Freundin von Kajo, mit ihrer Tochter Zoe zum Tennisturnier in Waldau erscheint, nutzt Sam die Gelegenheit, die Fahigkeiten der Schildkrote ausgiebig zu testen. programme.title: The tricks with ... / Die Tricks mit ...
programme.sub-title: Detergent, fabricate and Co. / Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co.
programme.desc: Whether fragrance promises, magical "renew" effects or XXL washing machines with a questionable drum size: a current NDR research for the competence center consumers reveals what is behind the marketing tricks of the detergent industry and how consumers are encouraged to buy. Pods and even washing leaves. The manufacturers promise the best washing results for all products. Which really washes best, reveal tests at the Niederrhein University of Applied Sciences. For a long time, detergents should no longer only clean the clothes. The products should also smell good too! Parliamented detergents are often advertised with "aromatherapy" or "deodorant fresh". But warning consumer protection: fragrances are not harmless to health and are critical of the environment in large quantities. Much of what the industry sells as an innovation is not used for clean washing - on the contrary. Interested in particular: detergent ingredients such as phosphonates or river plastics get over clarifiers into the river and can lead to environmental damage there. The latest research even suggests that the controversial glyphosate in waters is partly caused by degradation processes of detergent components. Many rates promise loads with eight, nine or even eleven kilos. But the NDR research shows that machines with identical drum -size, but with different large details, are sold - at different prices and with different energy efficiency labeling. Because when calculating the energy class, manufacturers have scope. Consumer protection demands: The criteria have to be stricter. In "the tricks with detergent, fabricate and Co." Find Anna Planken and Jo Hiller and the editorial team of the NDR: Not everything that smells cleans. And not everything that glows is good for health or environment. Anyone who dispenses with troubles and detergents properly dosed, but also washes more comfortable, but also more sustainable. / Ob Duftversprechen, magische "Renew"-Effekte oder XXL-Waschmaschinen mit fragwurdiger TrommelgroSSe: Eine aktuelle NDR-Recherche fur das Kompetenzcenter Verbraucher deckt auf, was hinter den Marketingtricks der Waschmittelindustrie steckt und wie Verbraucher zum Kaufen animiert werden.Die Produktvielfalt in den Regalen ist riesig: von Flussigwaschmitteln uber Pulver bis hin zu Kapseln, Pods und sogar Waschblattern. Bei allen Produkten versprechen die Hersteller beste Waschergebnisse. Welches wirklich am besten wascht, offenbaren Tests an der Hochschule Niederrhein. Waschmittel sollen allerdings langst nicht mehr nur die Kleidung reinigen. Gut riechen sollen die Produkte auch! Parfumierte Waschmittel werden oft mit "Aromatherapie" oder "Deo-Frische" beworben. Doch Verbraucherschutzer warnen: Duftstoffe sind gesundheitlich nicht unbedenklich und in groSSen Mengen kritisch fur die Umwelt. Vieles, was die Industrie als Innovation verkauft, wird fur saubere Wasche nicht gebraucht - im Gegenteil.Besonders besorgniserregend: Waschmittelinhaltsstoffe wie Phosphonate oder Flussigkunststoffe gelangen uber Klaranlagen in die Flusse und konnen dort zu Umweltschaden fuhren. Neueste Forschungen legen sogar nahe, dass das umstrittene Glyphosat in Gewassern teilweise durch Abbauprozesse von Waschmittelbestandteilen entsteht.Nicht nur bei Waschmitteln, auch bei Waschmaschinen wird getrickst. Viele Gerate versprechen Beladungen mit acht, neun oder sogar elf Kilo Wasche. Doch die NDR-Recherche zeigt: Es werden Maschinen mit identischer TrommelgroSSe, aber mit unterschiedlichen GroSSenangaben verkauft - zu unterschiedlichen Preisen und mit unterschiedlicher Energieeffizienzkennzeichnung. Denn bei der Berechnung der Energieklasse haben Hersteller Spielraum. Verbraucherschutzer fordern: Die Kriterien mussen strenger werden.In "Die Tricks mit Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co." finden Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam des NDR heraus: Nicht alles, was duftet, reinigt auch. Und nicht alles, was glanzt, ist gut fur Gesundheit oder Umwelt. Wer auf uberflussige Zusatze verzichtet und Waschmittel richtig dosiert, wascht nicht nur gunstiger, sondern auch nachhaltiger.

Das macht es dem Korper leichter, seine Kerntemperatur von 36,5 bis 37,5° C zu halten. Und nur mit dieser Kerntemperatur konnen alle Stoffwechselablaufe optimal funktionieren, kann der Korper reibungslos denken und agieren. Doch so sehr wir Warme lieben, eigentlich ist unser Korper deutlich gesunder und leistungsfahiger, wenn er standig wechselnden Temperaturen und vor allem Kaltereizen ausgesetzt ist. In der aktuellen Forschung gibt es mittlerweile viele Erkenntnisse, aber auch noch offene Fragen, wie Kalte auf den menschlichen Korper wirkt und wie wir sie fur unsere Gesundheit nutzen konnen.Die Dokumentation erzahlt, wie wir alle - jenseits von Spitzensport und Extremerlebnissen - von Kalte profitieren und unseren Korper an niedrigere Temperaturen gewohnen konnen. Die Autoren treffen u. a. die Lagerarbeiterin Katarzyna, die in einem Tiefkuhllager bei minus 22° C in Acht-Stunden-Schichten der Kalte trotzen muss. Wie gelingt ihr das und welche Rolle spielt ihr individuelles Kalteempfinden dabei?Begleitet wird auch die Extremschwimmerin Deniz Kayadelen bei ihren Vorbereitungen fur die Durchquerung des Ärmelkanals. Wie ist das zu schaffen: mehr als 33 Kilometer in nur 17° C kaltem Wasser? Was passiert in ihrem Korper? Der Kraftverlust der Muskulatur ist betrachtlich und geht schnell. Die Weiterleitung von Erregungsmustern gelingt immer schlechter. Das kann dazu fuhren, dass schon nach 15 Minuten in Wasser unter 15° C die gesamte Koordination der Schwimmbewegungen versagt und die Person ertrinkt. Aber Deniz Kayadelen versucht ihren Korper so zu trainieren, dass er seine Temperatur immer besser halten kann.Wie das gelingen kann, dazu forscht u. a. Dr. Erich Hohenauer von der University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland. Besonders interessiert ihn auch die Frage, ob Kaltereize tatsachlich das Immunsystem starken. Dazu fuhrt er Untersuchungen mit normalen, aber auch kalteerprobten Proband*innen durch. Einer davon ist der Biohacker Rolf Duda. Er wandert in Badehose durch Schneelandschaften und geht regelmaSSig Eisbaden. Nach einem traumatischen Erlebnis anderte er sein Leben und erfuhr durch sein Kaltetraining Heilung und mentale Starkung. Seine Erfahrungen damit gibt er mittlerweile in Kursen an andere Menschen weiter. Aber wie gelingt die mentale Starkung? Auch hier gibt es neue Forschungserkenntnisse aus der Psychologie.Im Spitzensport wird die Kaltetherapie ebenfalls immer ofter eingesetzt. Der Diskuswerfer Christoph Harting, Olympia-Sieger von 2016, sitzt unter arztlicher Leitung taglich in der Kaltekammer bei minus 110° C. Damit soll seine Fahigkeit zur korperlichen Regeneration gesteigert werden und auch kleinere Verletzungen wie Muskelfaserrisse heilen schneller, weil Korper und Extremitaten besser durchblutet werden.

programme.title: Work 4.0 - Does AI break my job? / Arbeit 4.0 - Macht KI meinen Job kaputt?
programme.desc: The weaving uprising, Henry Fords Fliessband, computer in the BURO: With every technical development boost, people have to fear for their work. It hasn't worried her for a long time: "After all, I do something with my head. Nobody can take that away from me." But now she wonders: how long? programme.desc: This time chef Andrew Zimmer explores the culinary legacy of Hyderabad. For example, Haleem, a meat dish that is located throughout the Orient, is very popular in the region. / Chefkoch Andrew Zimmern erkundet diesmal das kulinarische Erbe von Hyderabad. Zu den Kultgerichten der 400 Jahre alten indischen Stadt zahlt Hyderabadi Biryani, das aus Basmatireis und Huhnchen besteht und wurziger und herzhafter schmeckt als andere Biryani-Arten. Auch Einflusse muslimischer Lander haben die lokale Kuche gepragt. Sehr beliebt in der Region ist beispielsweise Haleem, ein Fleischgericht, das im gesamten Orient beheimatet ist.

Doch das milde, fast mediterrane Klima bietet zugleich auch wertvollen Lebensraum fur Tierarten, die oft versteckt und im Geheimen Licht und Warme suchen: Der Film "Sonnentiere der Wachau" taucht tief ein in diese weniger bekannte Seite des 36km langen Donautals zwischen Melk und Krems. programme.title: Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.title: Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.sub-title: Papstlicher als der Papst - Die Piusbruderschaft
programme.desc: The Pius Brotherhood, founded in 1970 by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre, sees the Catholic Church on a wrong way of modernism and rejects the reforms of the second Vatican Council as a contemporary catholic faith. Its to hold on to the old Tridentine liturgy is only the clearest extraordinary characteristic of her innermost beliefs. Nevertheless, talking to the Vatican has been running for many years to restore the full unit of the once excommunicated brotherhood with the Catholic Church - so far without a breakthrough. What principles do the members of the Pius Brotherhood - priest and laypersons - and how do they allow their view of the church, world and society? Peter Beringer's film follows these questions and also outlines the difficult story of the relationship with Rome. / Die Piusbruderschaft, 1970 von Erzbischof Marcel Lefebvre gegrundet, sieht die katholische Kirche auf einem Irrweg des Modernismus und lehnt die Reformen des Zweiten Vatikanischen Konzils als zeitgeistige Verwasserung des katholischen Glaubens ab. Ihr Festhalten an der alten tridentinischen Liturgie ist nur das deutlichste auSSere Merkmal ihrer innersten Überzeugungen. Dennoch laufen seit vielen Jahren Gesprache mit dem Vatikan, um die volle Einheit der einst exkommunizierten Bruderschaft mit der katholischen Kirche wieder herzustellen - bisher ohne Durchbruch. Nach welchen Prinzipien leben die Mitglieder der Piusbruderschaft - Priester und Laien - und wie begrunden sie ihre Sicht auf Kirche, Welt und Gesellschaft? Der Film von Peter Beringer geht diesen Fragen nach und skizziert dabei auch die schwierige Geschichte der Beziehung zu Rom.

programme.title: Sonnentiere der Wachau
programme.desc: The magnificent apricot blood, the blue church tower from Durnstein Abbey, the legendary castle ruin over the place of the same name or the steep wine terraces along the Danube. They are all worlds with a world call. But the mild, almost Mediterranean climate also offers valuable habitat for animal species, which often hidden and searched in secret light and warm: the film "Sonnen the Wachau" dipped deeply into this less known side of the 36km long Danube valley between Melk and Krems. Here, praying worshipers will find their preferred prey offer, rare emerald lizards are looking for shelter in natural stone walls and dangerous ground is comfortable on the dry grass. A film by Kurt Mundl / Die prachtvolle Marillenblute, der blaue Kirchturm von Stift Durnstein, die sagenumwobene Burgruine uber dem gleichnamigen Ort oder die steilen Weinterrassen entlang der Donau. Sie alle sind Wahrzeichen mit Weltruf. Doch das milde, fast mediterrane Klima bietet zugleich auch wertvollen Lebensraum fur Tierarten, die oft versteckt und im Geheimen Licht und Warme suchen: Der Film "Sonnentiere der Wachau" taucht tief ein in diese weniger bekannte Seite des 36km langen Donautals zwischen Melk und Krems. Hier finden Gottesanbeterinnen ihr bevorzugtes Beuteangebot, seltene Smaragdeidechsen suchen Unterschlupf in Natursteinmauern und gefahrdete Ziesel fuhlen sich auf den Trockenrasen wohl. programme.title: Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.title: KI: Maschinentraume im Film

programme.title: iHuman
programme.desc: Everyone is talking about Chatgpt. The mastermind behind the technology developed at Openaai is Ilya Sutskever, one of the experts who have their say in "Ihuman". The discussion, which has so far been played primarily into insider circles, about the profound consequences of artificial intelligence has been beating tall waves since Chatgpt4's discarding. "Ihuman" is a political thriller. He feels like a science fiction film and is about the here and now. The documentary reveals of artificial intelligence, power and social control. With a unique access to the booming AI industry, he shows how the most powerful technology of all time has our society, our future and our self-understanding. What are the consequences of the concentration of power of the billion dollar AI industry that knows hardly any state regulation and transparency? Some experts compare artificial intelligence with the atomic bomb because nobody can predict the consequences of this new technology. / ChatGPT ist in aller Munde. Das Mastermind hinter der bei OpenAI entwickelten Technologie ist Ilya Sutskever, einer der Experten, die in "iHuman" zu Wort kommen. Die bisher vor allem in Insiderkreisen gefuhrte Diskussion uber die tiefgreifenden Konsequenzen von Kunstlicher Intelligenz schlagt seit der Veroffentlichung von ChatGPT4 hohe Wellen."iHuman" ist ein politischer Thriller. Er fuhlt sich an wie ein Science-Fiction-Film und handelt doch vom Hier und Jetzt. Der Dokumentarfilm erzahlt von kunstlicher Intelligenz, Macht und sozialer Kontrolle. Mit einzigartigem Zugang zur boomenden KI-Industrie zeigt er, wie die machtigste Technologie aller Zeiten unsere Gesellschaft, unsere Zukunft und unser Selbstverstandnis verandert. Welche Konsequenzen hat die Machtkonzentration der milliardenschweren KI-Industrie, die kaum staatliche Regulierung und Transparenz kennt? Einige Experten vergleichen Kunstliche Intelligenz mit der Atombombe, da niemand die Konsequenzen dieser neuen Technologie vorhersagen kann.

programme.title: Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.title: Tatort

programme.desc: The discovery of a body raises questions: The man missing in the river near Nurnberg was buried two meters deep in the earth for two years.
