"On one day in September" can be found on the web and app of the ZDF from Saturday, September 6, 2025. / 14. September 1958: Im Privathaus des franzosischen Ministerprasidenten Charles de Gaulle wartet man auf den deutschen Kanzler Konrad Adenauer. Es ist die erste Begegnung der beiden.Mit Verzogerung beginnt das delikate, vor der Öffentlichkeit klein gehaltene Treffen, das die Erbfeindschaft zwischen Frankreich und Deutschland beenden soll. Schnell aber werden politische Differenzen deutlich. Die Annaherung droht zu scheitern.De Gaulles Frau Yvonne versucht den Druck, der auf der Begegnung lastet, bei jeder Gelegenheit zu lockern. Denn auch die Berater der beiden Staatsmanner, Gunther Bachmann und Gaston De Bonneval, tragen ihre fundamentalen Meinungsverschiedenheiten hinter den Kulissen mit offenem Visier aus.Vor den Toren von de Gaulles Privathaus in Colombey-les-Deux-Églises wartet eine kleine Schar Journalisten ungeduldig auf Ergebnisse. Dabei lernen sich die franzosische Fotografin Helène Wissembach und die deutsche Journalistik-Volontarin Elke Schmitz kennen. Beide traumen von einer friedlichen Zukunft in einem gemeinsamen Europa und fordern von den Politikern, sich dafur einzusetzen."An einem Tag im September" ist bereits ab Samstag, 6. September 2025 in Web und App des ZDF verfugbar.

programme.title: One day in September. The documentation / An einem Tag im September. Die Dokumentation
programme.desc: The documentary for the television film "On a day in September" reflects the first meeting in 1958 by Chancellor Adenauer with France's head of government De Gaulle at his private seat. It is a symbolic turn of the turn of Franco-German history. For centuries, the "hereditary enemy" had been in the relationship between the two countries. The statesmen had experienced the abyss of both world wars. How could you override this gap? For centuries, the wars between the neighbors leave deep traces. September 14, 1958 is considered a symbolic turning point: On this day, the German Chancellor Konrad Adenauer and the French Prime Minister Charles de Gaulle met for the first time in Colombey-les-deutix-Églises, where de Gaulle had his private country seat, the symbolism of which pointed to the future. In the following years there were 14 other encounters, partly spectacular, acclaimed joint appearances such as in Bonn or Reims. With their signature under the Elysee Treaty on January 22, 1963 and a warm hug, the statesmen fell the departure into a new era of intergovernmental relationships. Today the German-French tandem is considered a trend-setting engine for Europe, also in the face of new threats. Interview with the granddaughter of Konrad Adenauer, Bettina Adenauer, with Anne de Laroullière, granddaughter of Charles de Gaulle, with Adenauer's biographer Frank Bosch, director of the Leibniz Center for Commercial History Research in Potsdam and the biographer Gaulles Frederique Neau-Dufour and with Helène Miiard-Delacroix, professor at the Sorbonne in Paris add the documentation. / Die Doku zum Fernsehfilm "An einem Tag im September" reflektiert das erste Treffen 1958 von Bundeskanzler Adenauer mit Frankreichs Regierungschef de Gaulle auf dessen Privatsitz .Es ist ein symboltrachtiger Wendepunkt der deutsch-franzosischen Geschichte. Über Jahrhunderte galt im Verhaltnis der beiden Staaten die "Erbfeindschaft". Die Staatsmanner hatten die Abgrunde beider Weltkriege erlebt. Wie konnten sie diese Kluft uberbrucken?Über Jahrhunderte hinterlieSSen die Kriege zwischen den Nachbarn tiefe Spuren. Der 14. September 1958 gilt da als symbolischer Wendepunkt: An diesem Tag begegneten sich der deutsche Bundeskanzler Konrad Adenauer und der franzosische Regierungschef Charles de Gaulle zum ersten Mal in Colombey-les-Deux-Églises, wo de Gaulle seinen privaten Landsitz hatte.Es wurde ein herzliches Treffen, dessen Symbolik ganz in die Zukunft wies. In den folgenden Jahren gab es 14 weitere Begegnungen, teils spektakulare, umjubelte gemeinsame Auftritte wie in Bonn oder Reims. Mit ihrer Unterschrift unter den Elysee-Vertrag am 22. Januar 1963 und einer herzlichen Umarmung bekraftigten die Staatsmanner den Aufbruch in eine neue Ära zwischenstaatlicher Beziehungen. Heute gilt das deutsch-franzosische Tandem als richtungsweisender Motor fur Europa, auch angesichts neuer Bedrohungen.Interviews mit der Enkelin von Konrad Adenauer, Bettina Adenauer, mit Anne de Laroullière, Enkelin von Charles de Gaulle, mit Adenauers Biograf Frank Bosch, Direktor des Leibniz-Zentrums fur Zeithistorische Forschung in Potsdam und der Biografin de Gaulles Frederique Neau-Dufour sowie mit Helène Miard-Delacroix, Professorin an der Sorbonne in Paris erganzen die Dokumentation.

programme.title: Hannes Jaenicke: in action for the octopus / Hannes Jaenicke: Im Einsatz fur den Oktopus
programme.desc: About five million tons of ink fish land on the plate a year. Too many, says Hannes Jaenicke. His afternestry is one of the most fascinating sea creatures: the octopus. has to be an animal just before the extermination so that we are committed to it? The clear answer for Hannes Jaenicke is: "No" with researchers in Croatia, with animal welfare in Greece and sustainable fishermen in Indonesia, he goes on a journey. In the meantime, it is almost a delicacy all over the world. Demand and prizes have risen boldly in recent years. To date, every octopus that lands on a plate is caught in the sea. Nevertheless, the octopus on the red list is classified as not threatened. Actor and environmental protection officer Hannes Jaenicke's after -work applies to the octopus. Hannes Jaenicke shows in this film that the octopus combines high inherent intelligence in the event of great strangeness and that we can learn a lot from it. How does it adapt to his habitat continuously, which is always threatened? Hannes Jaenicke meets scientists who show him that octopuses are planning into the future, have personality and self -confidence and loose highly complex problems with their amazing mental memory. One of the best places is the Lembeh Strait, a sea route in the north of the Indonesian island of Sulawesi. The region is known for the highest concentration of unusual and diverse octopus species. Jaenicke is on the road with local diving guides, one of them is Ben. He has known the water for many years and has already collected many spectacular video recordings from octopuses. Hannes Jaenicke is also confronted in Indonesia with the effects of the horrendous plastic pollution and the practices of the fan fleets: In addition to basic towing networks that destroy the sample life on the bottom of the sea, illegal methods such as fishing with dynamite and pollution agents are also used here. This is exactly where Indonesian NGO Japesda comes in. The organization is committed to the protection of the oceans, places special emphasis on working with the local communities. In the Mediterranean, Jaenicke also focuses on in a disturbing facts: Here he accompanies the marine protection organization Sea Shepherd in hidden research that has revealed a wide -skating network of illegal fishing. He witnessed cruel deadlocks from octopuses. A Spanish fishing multi wants to open the world's first octopus breeding facility on an industrial scale. In contrast, researchers and environmentalists are running storm. The complex life cycle of an octopus can hardly be reproduced in captivity. Jaenicke wants to deal with assets and opponents. Are the same mistakes made here that are already known from factory farming on land? Jaenicke also searches for this. Science is regularly enthusiastic about the octopus with biological phenomena, its intelligence and fineness. How do we want to deal with the octopus in the future? As a raw material for industrial mass goods or as a miracle of evolution? With "in action for the octopus", Hannes Jaenicke wants to encourage you to rethink our relationship with nature and other living things and to see in a bigger okological context. Octopus? Squid? Who or what are octopuses? The plural already causes confusion: octopods or octopuses? Scientifically correct is octopods, but the colloquial octopuses have also established itself in language use. Continue with the conceptual clarification: octopods are octopuses! Robs belong to the molluscs (mollusks) and are therefore distant relatives of snails and mussels. Within the mollusced, you pay to the group of cephalopods. The word comes from the Greek and means head foot. The name aptly describes your anatomy: your arms (or if you will foot) are directly connected to your head. Cephalopods are extremely diverse: in addition to the octopods and eledons with their eight arms, there are also Kalmare and Sepien with ten arms as well as the bizarre nautilids who live in spiral shells and have around 90 tentacles. A total of over 800 species of cephalopods are known, including over 300 eight -armed octopuses. The broadcast can be streamed on ZDF from Sunday, August 10, 2025. / Etwa funf Millionen Tonnen Tintenfische landen pro Jahr auf dem Teller. Zu viele, meint Hannes Jaenicke. Sein nachster Einsatz gilt einem der faszinierendsten Meeresbewohner: dem Oktopus.Muss ein Tier erst kurz vor der Ausrottung stehen, damit wir uns fur es einsetzen? Fur Hannes Jaenicke lautet die klare Antwort: "Nein" Mit Forschern in Kroatien, mit Tierschutzern in Griechenland und nachhaltigen Fischern in Indonesien macht er sich auf die Reise.Die Fangquoten von Tintenfischen haben sich in zehn Jahren verzehnfacht. Mittlerweile gilt er fast auf der ganzen Welt als Delikatesse. Nachfrage und Preise stiegen in den letzten Jahren sprunghaft an. Bis heute wird jeder Oktopus, der auf einem Teller landet, im Meer gefangen. Trotzdem ist der Oktopus auf der Roten Liste als nicht bedroht eingestuft. Schauspieler und Umweltschutzer Hannes Jaenickes nachster Einsatz gilt trotzdem dem Oktopus.Hannes Jaenicke zeigt in diesem Film, dass der Oktopus bei groSStmoglicher Fremdheit eine hohe menschenahnliche Intelligenz in sich vereint und wir viel von ihm lernen konnen. Wie passt er sich fortlaufend an seinen Lebensraum an, der immer starker bedroht ist? Hannes Jaenicke trifft Wissenschaftler, die ihm zeigen, dass Kraken in die Zukunft planen, Personlichkeit und ein Selbstbewusstsein haben und mit ihrem erstaunlichen Denkvermogen hochkomplexe Probleme losen.Hannes Jaenicke will den Tieren in freier Wildbahn naherkommen. Einer der besten Orte dafur ist die Lembeh Strait, eine MeeresstraSSe im Norden der indonesischen Insel Sulawesi. Die Region ist bekannt fur die hochste Konzentration ungewohnlicher und vielfaltiger Krakenarten. Jaenicke ist mit einheimischen Tauchguides unterwegs, einer von ihnen ist Ben. Er kennt die Gewasser seit vielen Jahren und hat schon viele spektakulare Videoaufnahmen von Oktopussen gesammelt. Hannes Jaenicke wird in Indonesien aber auch mit den Auswirkungen der horrenden Plastikverschmutzung und den Praktiken der Fangflotten konfrontiert: Neben Grundschleppnetzen, die samtliches Leben am Meeresgrund zerstoren, kommen hier auch illegale Methoden wie das Fischen mit Dynamit und Betaubungsmitteln zum Einsatz. Genau hier setzt die indonesische NGO Japesda an. Die Organisation engagiert sich fur den Schutz der Meere, legt dabei besonderen Wert auf die Zusammenarbeit mit den lokalen Gemeinschaften.Auch im Mittelmeer stoSSt Jaenicke auf verstorende Tatsachen: Hier begleitet er die Meeresschutzorganisation Sea Shepherd bei versteckten Recherchen, die ein weitlaufiges Netz illegaler Fischerei aufgedeckt hat. Er wird Zeuge grausamer Totungsmethoden von Oktopussen.Sind Krakenfarmen eine Losung? Ein spanischer Fischerei-Multi will demnachst die erste Kraken-Zuchtanlage der Welt im industriellen MaSSstab eroffnen. Forschende und Umweltschutzer laufen dagegen Sturm. Der komplexe Lebenszyklus eines Oktopus lasst sich in Gefangenschaft kaum nachbilden. Jaenicke will sich mit Befurwortern und Gegnern auseinandersetzen. Werden hier die gleichen Fehler gemacht, die von der Massentierhaltung an Land bereits bekannt sind?Auch darauf sucht Jaenicke Antworten. Die Wissenschaft begeistert der Oktopus regelmaSSig mit biologischen Phanomenen, seiner Intelligenz und Feinfuhligkeit. Wie wollen wir mit dem Oktopus in Zukunft umgehen? Ihm als Rohstoff fur industrielle Massenware oder als Wunderwerk der Evolution begegnen? Mit "Im Einsatz fur den Oktopus" will Hannes Jaenicke dazu anregen, unsere Beziehung zur Natur und anderen Lebewesen neu zu denken und in einem groSSeren okologischen Zusammenhang zu sehen.Krake? Oktopus? Tintenfisch? Wer oder was sind Oktopusse eigentlich? Schon der Plural sorgt fur Verwirrung: Oktopoden oder Oktopusse? Wissenschaftlich korrekt ist Oktopoden, aber das umgangssprachliche Oktopusse hat sich ebenfalls im Sprachgebrauch etabliert. Weiter mit der Begriffserklarung: Oktopoden sind Kraken! Kraken gehoren zu den Weichtieren (Mollusken) und sind damit entfernte Verwandte von Schnecken und Muscheln. Innerhalb der Weichtiere zahlen sie zur Gruppe der Cephalopoden. Das Wort kommt aus dem Griechischen und bedeutet KopffuSSer. Der Name beschreibt treffend ihre Anatomie: Ihre Arme (oder wenn man so will FuSSe) sind direkt mit dem Kopf verbunden. Cephalopoden sind auSSerst vielfaltig: Neben den Oktopoden und Eledonen mit ihren acht Armen gibt es noch Kalmare und Sepien mit zehn Armen sowie die bizarren Nautiliden, die in spiraligen Schalen leben und rund 90 Tentakel besitzen. Insgesamt sind uber 800 Arten von Cephalopoden bekannt, darunter uber 300 achtarmige Kraken.Die Sendung kann bereits ab Sonntag, 10. August 2025 im ZDF gestreamt werden.

Silva erfahrt von Burke die Wahrheit uber die Ereignisse in Florida, die von der Navy vertuscht wurden.

programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.desc: Under the interference of the European Handball Organization since 1961. The Champions League is held for the best female teams of the Old Continent. Format takmičenja je takav da 16 najboljih ekipa kroz grupnu fazu i četvrtfinala lovi jednu od četiri pozicije za završni turnir Lige šampiona na kojem se preko polufinala i finala dobija novi prvak Evrope.

programme.title: Real Sociedad vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4
programme.desc: Real Sociedad have lost their last four LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in the last three. The San Sebastián side have never lost four consecutive matches without scoring against Los Blancos in the history of the competition. Real Madrid have won 12 of the 21 matches they have played at Anoeta against Real Sociedad in LaLiga in the 21st Century, becoming the away team with the most wins at the San Sebastian sides ground in the competition since then.

programme.title: West Ham United vs Tottenham Hotspur - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4
programme.desc: West Ham have won just one of their last seven Premier League matches against Tottenham Hotspur, a 2-1 away win in December 2023. Each of the last three Premier League meetings between West Ham and Spurs at the London Stadium have ended as 1-1 draws – Spurs are winless in five league visits since a 3-2 win in November 2019.

programme.title: Brentford vs Chelsea - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4
programme.desc: Just one of the eight Premier League meetings between Brentford and Chelsea have been won by the home side, a 2-1 win for the Blues in December 2024. Brentford have won three Premier League matches against Chelsea but all of them have been away from home – at home, they are winless in four against the Blues.

programme.title: Real Sociedad vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4
programme.desc: Real Sociedad have lost their last four LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in the last three. Real Madrid have won 12 of the 21 matches they have played at Anoeta against Real Sociedad in LaLiga in the 21st Century, becoming the away team with the most wins at the San Sebastian sides ground in the competition since then.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Nottingham Forest - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: In all competitions, Arsenal have won their last six home games against Nottingham Forest by an aggregate score of 19-2. The Gunners are unbeaten in 14 games on home soil against Forest since a 3-1 defeat back in March 1989. Nottingham Forest have won just two out of 16 Premier League matches against Arsenal and both wins came at the City Ground, in 1996-97 and 2022-23.

programme.title: EPL Stories 2025/2026
programme.desc: Showcasing the personalities who have shaped the Premier League era, in each episode we tell their unique story that will be sure to engage and entertain all fans.

programme.title: Burnley vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4
programme.desc: Burnley have lost 14 of their 18 Premier League matches against Liverpool, including each of their last five in a row since a 1-0 win at Anfield in January 2021. Liverpool have won eight of their nine away Premier League matches at Turf Moor against Burnley, winning the last six in a row. The Reds have won seven away top-flight games in a row against three teams previously: West Brom, Norwich and Crystal Palace.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United, though they failed to win either game last season for the first time since 2020-21. Manchester United have inflicted 25% of Pep Guardiola’s total home Premier League defeats as Man City manager, with the Red Devils winning four times there against the Spaniard. They are looking for consecutive wins at the Etihad for the first time since March 2021.

programme.title: Barcelona vs Valencia - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4
programme.desc: Barcelona have not lost any of their last 10 matches against Valencia in LaLiga, their second-best unbeaten run against Los Che in their history in the competition, after a run of 13 matches between 2007 and 2013. Valencia have conceded at least one goal in each of their last 21 away games against FC Barcelona in LaLiga, since a 1-0 win in October 2003 under Rafa Benítez, their worst current run without keeping a clean sheet against the same opponent in the competition.

programme.title: Canada vs USA - 3rd Place - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: Bronze is on the line after a quick turnaround. The USA are record AmeriCup winners with seven titles, while Canada are chasing a statement podium. The senior series favors the USA 21–2, although the most recent major clash flipped the script: Canada beat the USA 127–118 after overtime for 2023 World Cup bronze in Manila. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 bronze game, which the USA won 84–80. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: USA No. 1, Canada No. 6. Bench depth, defensive rebounding, and three-point efficiency are likely to separate them.

programme.title: Argentina vs Brazil - Final - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: South America’s classic rivalry decides the AmeriCup. Argentina are the reigning champions with three titles (2001, 2011, 2022), while Brazil are four-time winners (1984, 1988, 2005, 2009). Argentina lead the senior head-to-head 25–17. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 final in Recife, which Argentina won 75–73; at the 2019 World Cup second round, Argentina won 87–73. programme.title: Nimes vs Tremblay - LNH Division 1 - French Handball Starligue
programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.desc: The Qatari League is the official football league in Qatar. The league includes 12 teams. programme.title: Nikola karabatic 20 Years Of Glory
programme.desc: Renowned as one of the greatest handball players of the century, Nikola retires on May 31 after his final game with PSG Handball. His career concludes with the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. A four-time World Champion, three-time Olympic gold medalist, and three-time World Handball Player of the Year, Nikola plans to take a break from his career to spend more time with his family.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 257 / MMA UFC 257
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Željezničar - Fighter / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Željezničar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Joker - Tamis / Košarka - KLS: Joker - Tamiš
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. Some of them found the love of your life here, found homes, friends for all life, get citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: The show for all lovers of this sport, which are fed up with industrial, high-cost football, for those who are a lot of tacticals and games without goals. programme.title: Football - Europa League / Fudbal - Liga Evrope
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Kosarka - Euroleague: Olympiacos - Panathinaikos, sword for 3rd month / Košarka - Euroleague: Olympiacos - Panathinaikos, meč za 3.mesto
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: CSKA - UNICS / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - UNICS
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Bejzbol - MLB: Milwaukee Brewers - Philadephia Phillies
programme.desc: MLB or Major League Baseball is the highest rank of baseball league in North America. League beginners already before the end of the 19th century, in 1876. When the first season of the Netherlands' first season was played. 1903. Today's structure was formed with the first edition of World Series. The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that selects the Plejof two best play the World Series Final. The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili Major League Baseball je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.desc: We tell a fairy tale every morning for your toddlers. / Vsako jutro pripovedujemo pravljico za vaše malčke.

programme.desc: Join a passionate traveler and photographer Tomaž Gorc in discovering the beautiful corners of the world. / Pridružite se strastnemu popotniku in fotografu Tomažu Gorcu pri odkrivanju čudovitih kotičkov sveta.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake devotes a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: Bud Spencer: Even Angels eat beans / Bud Spencer: Tudi angeli jedo fižol
programme.desc: An important local gangster "Sorriso" mistakenly exchanges them for their dangerous killers. With the help of many ridiculous coincidences, the boys, in order to survive, pretend to be "Sorris" guard until they are assigned to murder their members of one poor family. But what if they reveal their true identity? / Pomemben lokalni gangster "Sorriso" ju pomotoma zamenja za svoja nevarna morilca. S pomočjo številnih smešnih naključij, se fanta, da bi preživela, pretvarjata, da sta "Sorrisova" varovanca, dokler jima ni dodeljena naloga umoriti člane ene revne družine. Kaj pa če razkrinkajo njuni pravi identiteti?

programme.title: Nostalgia: Amanda Lipus / Nostalgija: Amanda Lipuš
programme.desc: Nostalgia takes us into the world of memories of musical legends. / Nostalgija nas popelje v svet spominov glasbenih legend.Spomnimo se njihovih začetkov in uspehov ter z nostalgično glasbo pričaramo lepe spomine na glasbenike z veliko začetnico.

programme.title: Polka in majolka
programme.desc: For years, the Polka and Majolka show has been entertained by viewers by presenting national ensembles at locations around Slovenia. They travel around the country, promoting places and Slovenian folk music. / Oddaja Polka in majolka že leta zabava gledalce s predstavitvijo narodnozabavnih ansamblov na lokacijah po Sloveniji. Potujejo po državi, promovirajo kraje in slovensko narodnozabavno glasbo.

programme.title: Pikado zabava
programme.desc: "Darts Party" goes to the fourth round - and this time, too, is no less than a normal tournament. 24 participants compete in a multi -week competition against each other. Each week, six -member groups are fighting to enter the finals - including in rotating platforms, slippery soils or flying obstacles. Only when these obstacles are overcome that it is allowed to target the board. It takes precision, concentration and athletics - providing excellent entertainment. At the end of the week, four daily winners meet in a tense weekly finals - only one manages to break into the big serial finals. / "Darts Party" gre v četrti krog – in tudi tokrat ni nič manj kot običajen turnir. 24 udeležencev se pomeri v večtedenskem tekmovanju drug proti drugemu. Vsak teden se šestčlanske skupine borijo za vstop v finale – med drugim na vrtečih se platformah, spolzkih tleh ali pred letečimi ovirami. Šele ko so te ovire premagane, je dovoljeno ciljati na tablo. Potrebni so natančnost, koncentracija in atletika – kar zagotavlja odlično zabavo. Na koncu tedna se štirje dnevni zmagovalci srečajo v napetem tedenskem finalu – le enemu uspe preboj v veliki serijski finale.

programme.title: Darts: Final - semi -finals and finals / Pikado: Finale - Polfinale in Finale
programme.desc: Der Amual World Champion Luke Littler won the World Series of Darts Finals in 2024. "The Nuke" was a big favorite before this year's tournament, as the Englishman won both the Australian Masters and the New Zealand Masters. These two events were the latest tournaments of the World Series of Darts this year. Among the passionate lovers of darts, the 18-year-old miracle boy is primarily known for his efficiency in the double 10 conclusions. / Der amtualni svetovni prvak Luke Littler je leta 2024 osvojil World Series of Darts Finals. "The Nuke" je bil pred letošnjim turnirjem velik favorit, saj je Anglež zmagal tako na Australian Masters kot tudi na New Zealand Masters. Ti dve prireditvi sta bili zadnja turnirja serije World Series of Darts v tem letu. Med strastnimi ljubitelji pikada je 18-letni čudežni deček predvsem znan po svoji učinkovitosti pri zaključkih na dvojni 10.

programme.title: Exatlon Germany: Mega Challenge: Battle of the Cities / EXATLON Nemčija: Mega izziv: Battle of the Cities
Iskanje ameriških zakladov: Dvosledna vozila in samuraji
programme.desc: There are treasures in the towns and along the fast roads of the United States who just wait for anyone to discover them - valuable historical antiques, hidden in the piles of charms, buried in barns and folded in garages. Only special experts know how to find these lost rusty objects and, if possible, turn them into wealth. forgotten. Along the way, they get to know people whose stories open a window into American life and history. / V mestecih in ob zakotnih cestah ZDA so zakladi, ki le čakajo, da jih kdo odkrije – dragocene zgodovinske starine, ki so skrite v kupih šare, zakopane v skednjih in zložene v garažah. Le posebni strokovnjaki znajo poiskati te izgubljene zarjavele predmete in jih po možnosti spremeniti v bogastvo.Serija Ameriški nabiralci spremlja dva izmed najizkušenejših "nabiralcev" – Mika Wolfa, lastnika trgovine z arheološkimi starinami Antique Archaeology, in njegovega poslovnega partnerja Franka Fritza – medtem ko iščeta predmete z zgodovinsko, zbirateljsko in popularno kulturno vrednostjo, na katere so njihovi lastniki že davno pozabili. Na poti spoznavata ljudi, katerih zgodbe odpirajo okno v ameriško življenje in zgodovino.

programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. In this game of high inserts, to overcome opponents who also want to enrich, it also requires a good nose for mild and steel nerves. Because these are large sums of money, this is not a game, but a real war. Meet John Kunkl's auctions and auction participants who are fighting for the best bargains, including Jason R. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Hockey (M): Olimpija - VSV, Ice Hockey League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Olimpija - VSV, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. Until 2005, only Austrian teams performed, and then, over the years, Slovenian, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Italian, Hungary and Slovakia joined. There are 14 teams in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Hockey (M): Olimpija - VSV, Ice Hockey League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Olimpija - VSV, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. Until 2005, only Austrian teams performed, and then, over the years, Slovenian, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Italian, Hungary and Slovakia joined. There are 14 teams in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Memories: prof. dr. Niko Tosh, 2. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 2. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.title: Ponikve Folklore Group: Tango for three, Mon. / Folklorna skupina Ponikve: Tango za tri, pon.
programme.desc: R: Vojko Vidmar ... The Ponikve Folklore Group, coming from Dobrepolje, will present a waltz, polka and tango on stage. This, as is less well known, was part of the dance culture in Slovenia, since it is found here at the beginning of the last century. Tango is already stereotypically perceived as a dance of passion, so in the choreography of Tomaž Simetinger, a passionate competing for the love of a girl who grows into a clash of two dancers for the same dancer. / R: Vojko Vidmar... Folklorna skupina Ponikve, ki prihaja iz Dobrepolja bo na odru predstavila valček, polko in tudi tango. Ta je bil, kot je morda manj znano, del plesne kulture na Slovenskem, saj ga pri nas zasledimo že v začetku prejšnjega stoletja. Tango že kar stereotipno dojemamo kot ples strasti, zato se v koreografiji Tomaža Simetingerja prepleta strastno potegovanje za ljubezen dekleta, ki prerašča v spopad dveh plesalcev za isto plesalko.

They presented themselves in solo choreography from Ballet Gusar, contemporary solo choreography entitled Departure and Group Choreographies from the Coppelia ballet. Director Aljaž Bastič. / R: Bastič Aljaž... V studijski televizijski upodobitvi se predstavljajo izbrani mladi baletni talenti, najboljši plesalci mariborskega Konservatorija za glasbo in balet. Pod mentorstvom Nikolaja Čilnikova, Galine Dimitrijeve, Vasilija Kuzkina in Martine Svetina so nastopili dijaki in dijakinje prvega, drugega, tretjega in četrtega letnika. Predstavili so se v solistični koreografiji iz baleta Gusar, sodobni solistični koreografiji z naslovom Odhajanje in skupinski koreografiji iz baleta Coppelia. Režiser Aljaž Bastič.

programme.sub-title: The Wonders of Europe / Leurope des Mervilles II; The second season of the documentary series of Wonder Europe reveals the history of four unique European landmarks: the Eiffel Tower, the Flores Cathedral, the Roman Pantheon and the magnificent Schonbrunn mansion on / The Wonders Of Europe / Leurope Des Merveilles Ii.; Druga sezona dokumentarne serije Čudesa Evrope razkriva zgodovino štirih edinstvenih evropskih znamenitosti: Eifflovega stolpa, firenške stolnice, rimskega Panteona in veličastnega dvorca Schonbrunn na
programme.desc: Part 2: Roman Pantheon, Oda to the Empire, reveals the stunning history of one of the most famous shrines of all time, the Roman Pantheon, "Temple of all the gods." It was built by Consul Mark Agrip, around the year 25 BC, at the time of the reign of his good friend, the first Roman emperor Augustus. After two devastating fires, 150 years later, he was rebuilt and upgraded by Emperor Hadrian, a passionate lover of architecture. His creation, the famous giant's concrete dome, with which he covered the pantheon, still admires the whole world today. The Wonders of Europe II. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte. / 2. del: Rimski Panteon, oda cesarstvuDrugi del razkriva osupljivo zgodovino enega najznamenitejših svetišč vseh časov, rimskega Panteona, »templja vseh bogov«. Zgraditi ga je dal konzul Mark Agripa, in sicer okrog leta 25 pred našim štetjem, v času vladanja njegovega dobrega prijatelja, prvega rimskega cesarja Avgusta. Po dveh uničujočih požarih ga je 150 let pozneje obnovil in nadgradil cesar Hadrijan, strasten ljubitelj arhitekture. Njegovo stvaritev, slovito orjaško betonsko kupolo, s katero je pokril Panteon, še danes občuduje ves svet. THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte.

programme.desc: Despite being a great Marseille police, Alex Hugo, seized tenderness, chooses to escape the city and the violence that could no longer endure and take refuge in the mountains. programme.title: Alex Hugo
programme.desc: One afternoon, in Lusagne, the children in the camp return to a long excursion in the mountains, but the 10 -year -old Justine is not there. Her monitor, Marianne Helme, goes out to look for her, but she does not return. And soon it will get dark. / Una tarda, a Lusagne, els nens del campament tornen duna llarga excursio per la muntanya, però la Justine, de 10 anys, no hi es. La seva monitora, la Marianne Helme, surt a buscar-la, però tampoc torna. I aviat es farà fosc.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: Agents have conformed Dieter Bannow, the owner of a bar, who has his little bit poisoned and is in a coma. The cause has been a chocolate that sells his grandfather. programme.title: gesundheitheute
programme.sub-title: Fit in the head into old age / Fit im Kopf bis ins hohe Alter
programme.desc: In Switzerland, every quarter of an hour falls ill with Alzheimer's or another form of dementia. 157,000 people are currently affected. The number of dementia patients will double by 2050, according to Alzheimer's Switzerland. Are we at the mercy of dementia? No, say the neuroscientist Dr. Barbara Studer and the multiple Esterreich Memorial Champion and Memo coach Luise Maria Sommer. They give valuable advice. Vaccination against humane papillomaviruses The so -called human papilloma viruses are highly contagious. Statistics show that almost 80 percent of adults are infected in the course of their lives. In the half of the infected, the viruses disappear again, but they can also cause genital warts and throat and exhaust nut cancer. For this reason, vaccination from the age of eleven is recommended - and not only for girls, but also for boys. / In der Schweiz erkrankt jede Viertelstunde eine Person neu an Alzheimer oder einer anderen Form von Demenz. Derzeit sind 157000 Menschen betroffen. Bis 2050 wird sich die Zahl der Demenzpatienten verdoppeln, so die Prognose von Alzheimer Schweiz. Sind wir der Demenz schutzlos ausgeliefert? Nein, sagen die Neurowissenschaftlerin Dr. Barbara Studer und die mehrfache osterreichische Gedachtnisweltmeisterin und Memo-Coach Luise Maria Sommer. Sie geben wertvolle Ratschlage.Impfung gegen Humane Papillomaviren Die sogenannten Humanen Papillomaviren sind hochansteckend. Statistiken zeigen, dass sich fast 80 Prozent der Erwachsenen im Laufe ihres Lebens damit infizieren. Bei der Halfte der Infizierten verschwinden die Viren wieder, sie konnen jedoch auch Genitalwarzen und Rachen- und Gebarmutterkrebs verursachen. Aus diesem Grund wird eine Impfung ab elf Jahren empfohlen - und zwar nicht nur fur Madchen, sondern auch fur Jungen.

programme.title: What is sacred to us / Was uns heilig ist

programme.desc: In India, Frooty Bherulalji Mutha Seelen peace. She has been living as a Jain-Nonne for three years. The path with the name Sankan Sando symbolizes birth, death and rebirth. And the Italian pilgrim Luigimario Perreti can be accompanied on a section of the Jakobsweg. / In Indien mochte Frooty Bherulalji Mutha Seelenfrieden erlangen. In der nordostlich von Tokio gelegenen Region Tohoku besteigen Pilgernde drei heilige Berge. Der Weg mit dem Namen Sankan Sando versinnbildlicht Geburt, Tod und Wiedergeburt. Fur Meister Hoshino ist diese Wallfahrt ein Initiationsritus, bei dem er die uralte japanische Religion des Shugendo an die Nachwelt weitergeben kann. programme.title: Media under pressure - does journalism still have a future? / Medien unter Druck - Hat Journalismus noch eine Zukunft?
programme.desc: The media industry is in a profound crisis: the requirements have been decreasing for years, and advertising revenues are breaking away. Publishers and the Public service break down staff and funds. The result: The resources are missing for well -founded research, instead service items and easy food dominate. At the same time, many readers are no longer repressing through classic media and - when at all - only in social media is still rampant, where emotion and disinformation are rampant. What do these developments mean for the democratic public? How does artificial intelligence change journalism, and who is still ready to pay for journalism today? In addition, Olivia Rollin speaks to Roger de Weck, former SRG general director, and author of "The principle nevertheless - why we have to save journalism from the media", and with Jennifer Wilton, journalist and former editor -in -chief of the German daily newspaper. / Die Medienbranche steckt in einer tiefgreifenden Krise: Seit Jahren sinken die Auflagen, Werbeeinnahmen brechen weg. Verlage und der Service public bauen Personal und Mittel ab. Die Folge: Fur fundierte Recherchen fehlen die Ressourcen, stattdessen dominieren Service-Artikel und leichte Kost. Gleichzeitig fuhlen sich viele Lesende durch klassische Medien nicht mehr reprasentiert und informieren sich - wenn uberhaupt - nur noch in sozialen Medien, wo Emporung und Desinformation grassieren. Was bedeuten diese Entwicklungen fur die demokratische Öffentlichkeit? Wie verandert kunstliche Intelligenz den Journalismus, und wer ist heute noch bereit, fur Journalismus zu bezahlen?Daruber spricht Olivia Rollin mit Roger de Weck, ehemaliger SRG-Generaldirektor, und Autor von «Das Prinzip Trotzdem - Warum wir den Journalismus vor den Medien retten mussen», und mit Jennifer Wilton, Journalistin und ehemalige Chefredakteurin der deutschen Tageszeitung «Die Welt».

Ihr Grossvater hatte im damaligen Jugoslawien und heutigen Kroatien selber einen Filmprojektor gebaut und eines der ersten Kinos im Land eroffnet. Über den Vater griff der Filmvirus auch auf die beiden Bruder uber. Die Wohnungen der beiden in Luzern sind vollgestopft mit Filmrequisiten, vornehmlich aus dem Horrorbereich.Zehneinhalb Zimmer, 400 Quadratmeter Wohnflache und 3000 Quadratmeter Umschwung durfen Martin Jaggi und seine Lebenspartnerin Ursula Wenk ihr Eigen nennen. 2012 hatten sie in Wolfwil SO ein leerstehendes Restaurant entdeckt und sich schockverliebt. Ursula betreibt in dem Haus auch eine Praxis fur Farbtherapie und Martin Jaggi nutzt es als Proberaum fur seine Musik. Als Ralph Martens hat er sich auch einen Namen als Musiker gemacht. Daneben ist er Unternehmer und betreibt ein Tanksaulen- und Oldtimer-Museum.Und dann landen Viola und Jan auch noch spontan in Langenthal und uberraschen dort einen Mallehrer, dessen Loft den beiden von einem ehemaligen Schuler empfohlen worden ist.

programme.title: Black Mass
programme.desc: James “Whitey” Bulger was one of the most famous gangsters in US history. In the 1970s and 1980s, Bulger dominated the Boston underworld and bushed millions with drugs, blackmail, jaw game and numerous other dark. Bulger grew up in Sud-Boston and developed from the street child to the hard-boiled criminal, which finally rose to an murderly unscrupulous mafia boss in the area of ​​the Irish gangster clans. He enriched himself with drugs and blackmails. In doing so, he attracted a gang of hits, which murdered their rivals without zogen and disposed of the corpses in cellars and silencing in the entire Boston area, which he was able to act without penalty, while his brother Billy held the chair of the Senate of the state of Massachusett, is only one of the incredible stories that come up with the gangster. Bulger always claims that he simply paid the federal officials to look away. But the truth is more worrying. In 1974 Bulger was registered as an informant and then worked with the FBI, supposedly to bring the mafia to fall. In return, immunity was preserved for his own criminal activities. Any attempt to investigate him was canceled, rejected or sabotaged. To this day, the relationship between the FBI and Bulger is a shameful stain for the call of the behavior. / James «Whitey» Bulger war einer der beruchtigtsten Gangster der US-Geschichte. In den 1970er- und 80er-Jahren beherrschte Bulger die Bostoner Unterwelt und scheffelte Millionen mit Drogen, Erpressung, Glucksspiel und zahlreichen anderen finsteren Geschaften. Bulger wuchs in Sud-Boston auf und entwickelte sich vom Strassenkind zum hartgesottenen Kriminellen, der schliesslich im Umfeld der irischen Gangster-Clans zu einem morderisch skrupellosen Mafiaboss aufstieg. Er bereicherte sich mit Drogengeschaften und Erpressungen. Dabei fuhrte er eine Bande von Schlagern an, die ihre Rivalen ohne zu zogern ermordeten und die Leichen in Kellern und Sumpfen im gesamten Bostoner Raum entsorgten.Dass er dabei straffrei agieren konnte, wahrend sein Bruder Billy den Vorsitz im Senat des Bundesstaates Massachusetts innehatte, ist nur eine der unglaublichen Storys, die sich um den Gangster ranken. Bulger behauptet immer, er habe die Bundesbeamten einfach dafur bezahlt, wegzusehen. Die Wahrheit aber ist beunruhigender. 1974 liess sich Bulger als Informant registrieren und arbeitete danach mit dem FBI zusammen, angeblich, um die Mafia zu Fall zu bringen. Im Gegenzug wurde ihm Immunitat fur seine eigenen kriminellen Aktivitaten gewahrt. Jeder Versuch, gegen ihn zu ermitteln, wurde abgebrochen, umgelenkt oder sabotiert. Bis zum heutigen Tag ist die Beziehung des FBI zu Bulger ein Schandfleck fur den Ruf der Behorde.

programme.desc: Tom Cruise returns as Pete "Maverick" Mitchell, the old hot spur from "Top Gun" from 1986. An enemy nation ran up the production in an uranium system hidden between two mountains. Hunting it into the air is a dangerous and practically impossible task. Maverick's task is to train the young, talented pilots of the pilot school for this task. In between, bar owner Penny, who is sometimes more, sometimes less lined up with Maverick. She might bring a little stabilization into his life, provided that he is ready to accept it. Even if the film does not take unexpected twists, “Maverick” offers fast-paced and exciting action, with heart and a visual flair that pays a nostalgic homage to a style that redefined the blockbuster cinema in 1986, but has now enjoyed classic status. / Tom Cruise kehrt zuruck als Pete «Maverick» Mitchell, der alt gewordene Heisssporn aus «Top Gun» von 1986. Mavericks Aufgabe ist es, die jungen, talentierten Piloten der Flieger-Schule fur diese Aufgabe auszubilden. Es scheint, als habe das Schicksal sie zusammengefuhrt. Die beiden lernen sich kennen und helfen sich uber die schwierige Zeit hinweg. Schliesslich kommen sie sich naher.

programme.title: Liebe im Sonnenblumenfeld
programme.desc: Assistant Kate introduces her boss an idea: her grandmother has brought together couples again and again. Kate's dream of a career as a journalist jerks more, because she is supposed to find out more about history with newcomer Drew. They travel to their old homeland and ask the many happily couples. The connection between Kate and Drew is getting tighter. / Assistentin Kate stellt ihrer Chefin eine Idee vor: ihre Oma hat fruher immer wieder Paare zusammengebracht. Kates Traum von einer Karriere als Journalistin ruckt naher, denn sie soll mit Newcomer Drew mehr uber die Geschichte herausfinden. Sie reisen in ihre alte Heimat und befragen die vielen noch immer glucklichen Paare. Dabei wird die Verbindung zwischen Kate und Drew immer enger.

programme.title: Say Oui to love / Sag OUI zur Liebe
programme.desc: An event planner can hardly wait to be there at the wedding of her best friend in Paris - and to plan them. However, when she finds out that her ex brings a date, she meets her childhood immediately. / Eine Eventplanerin kann es kaum erwarten, bei der Hochzeit ihrer besten Freundin in Paris dabei zu sein - und diese zu planen. Als sie jedoch herausfindet, dass ihr Ex ein Date mitbringt, trifft sie sich mit ihrem Brieffreund aus der Kindheit.
